commit.message: feat(conport): add decision-to-decision typed relationship REST routes and MCP tools

pr.title: feat(conport): decision-to-decision typed relationship routes + MCP tools
pr.body: Activates the decision_relationships table (separate from entity_relationships; consolidation is explicitly deferred as a future refactor). Adds POST /api/decisions/{id}/relationships to create a typed link and GET /api/decisions/{id}/relationships to list all edges for a decision. Allowed relationship_type values: builds_upon, supersedes, conflicts_with, validates, implements, questions. Adds link_decisions and get_decision_relationships MCP tools in server.py and JSON-RPC handlers in conport_mcp_stdio.py.

steps.task: Preflight: create a fresh dedicated worktree from origin/main. Verify repo marker, origin identity, branch, and clean baseline. Inspect schema.sql and all migration files to determine whether decision_relationships is already defined. Also confirm that entity_relationships exists (it should, per DMX-CONPORT-OPTIMAL-202 dependency). Record both findings in proof. Note: do NOT attempt to merge or alias these tables — they are intentionally separate.
validation: Worktree verified and recorded in proof.
decision_relationships table existence classified as EXISTS, ABSENT, or UNKNOWN.
entity_relationships confirmed present (or recorded as UNKNOWN if not found).
No merger of the two tables performed or planned.

steps.task: If S1 found decision_relationships ABSENT, create docker/mcp-servers-source/conport/migrations/010_decision_relationships.sql with: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, source_decision_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES decisions(id), target_decision_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES decisions(id), relationship_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relationship_type IN ('builds_upon','supersedes','conflicts_with','validates','implements','questions')), notes TEXT, created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(source_decision_id, target_decision_id, relationship_type). If EXISTS, skip and record NOT_RUN.
validation: Migration file created only when table was confirmed absent in S1.
SQL uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS.
CHECK constraint names exactly the six allowed relationship_type values.
UNIQUE constraint prevents duplicate typed edges.
If table already existed, step is recorded as NOT_RUN with reason.

steps.task: Write failing tests in docker/mcp-servers-source/conport/tests/test_decision_relationships.py covering: (a) POST /api/decisions/{id}/relationships creates a typed link and returns 201 with edge id; (b) GET /api/decisions/{id}/relationships lists all edges where id is source or target; (c) POST with an invalid relationship_type returns 400; (d) POST with unknown source_decision_id returns 404; (e) POST with unknown target_decision_id returns 404; (f) duplicate typed edge returns 409.
validation: All six test cases exist and fail (red) before production code is added.
Tests are self-contained and use in-process test client.

steps.task: Implement two REST routes in enhanced_server.py: POST /api/decisions/{decision_id}/relationships (body: target_decision_id required, relationship_type required from enum, notes optional) and GET /api/decisions/{decision_id}/relationships (returns all edges where decision_id is source or target, each edge includes both decision ids, type, notes, created_at). Validate relationship_type against the enum; fail-closed on invalid type, unknown ids, and duplicate edges.
validation: All six tests from S3 pass (green).
relationship_type enum validation is exhaustive — unknown types return 400, not 500.
Duplicate edge returns 409 (not a silent no-op).
No regression in other enhanced_server.py routes.

steps.task: Add two MCP tools in server.py: link_decisions (source_decision_id, target_decision_id, relationship_type, notes optional) and get_decision_relationships (decision_id). Add JSON-RPC handlers in conport_mcp_stdio.py following the existing handler pattern. relationship_type enum must be documented in the tool schema description.
validation: link_decisions and get_decision_relationships appear in the MCP tool listing.
JSON-RPC create and list round-trips succeed.
Tool schema documents all six valid relationship_type values.
Pattern consistency with existing tools confirmed.
